posts.name: Tanisha Agrawal
posts.cooked:
image1538×450 24.7 KB

I am not able to access the OPPE VM correctly. I have the OPPE today so kindly help me with this.

I shall be thankful.

posts.name: Anay Singh
posts.cooked:
The error message shows that remote host KEY changed since you last configured your passwordless login and accepted the remote host key. This can be resolved by deleting the specific remote host key in your local .ssh\known_hosts file. After this when you will login first time you will get option to add remote known host. Once accepted, your will be able to connect without password.

I hope this will solve your problem.

posts.name: Tanisha Agrawal
posts.cooked: I did everything as directed. But, now it says permission denied.

posts.name: Anay Singh
posts.cooked:
Generate your SSH key again on the oppe website.

Then try to login.
